statements.impact_statement: Debian: intended behaviour, will not fix in any release.
OpenSSL 3.x vulnerability not applicable to this build configuration.

CVE-2024-56171 affects libxml2 xmlSchemaIDCFillNodeTables (XML Schema validation). libxml2 2.13.4 is installed in the nginx:1.27.4-alpine base image but nginx does not link to it (verified via ldd /usr/sbin/nginx — no libxml2 reference). The rune-docs container serves only static HTML/CSS/JS files; no XML parsing or schema validation occurs. The vulnerable code path is unreachable in this deployment.

CVE-2025-49794 is a use-after-free and type confusion vulnerability in libxml2 xmlSchematronGetNode (Schematron validation module). libxml2 2.13.4 is installed in the nginx:1.27.4-alpine base image but nginx does not link to it (verified via ldd /usr/sbin/nginx — no libxml2 reference). The rune-docs container serves only static files; no XML or Schematron parsing occurs. The vulnerable code path is unreachable in this deployment.

CVE-2025-49796 is a type confusion vulnerability in libxml2 Schematron module. libxml2 2.13.4 is installed in the nginx:1.27.4-alpine base image but nginx does not link to it (verified via ldd /usr/sbin/nginx — no libxml2 reference). The rune-docs container serves only static files; no XML or Schematron parsing occurs. The vulnerable code path is unreachable in this deployment.
